name: Carnivorous Plant

behaviors.name: Corrode Metal
behaviors.description: Any unenhanced weapon made of metal that hits the plant corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. The plant can eat through 2-inch-thick, unenhanced metal in 1 round.

behaviors.name: False Appearance
behaviors.description: While the plant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal plant.

behaviors.name: Bite
behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) kinetic damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

sectionText: While most plants are harmless, many plants are malicious and self-aware, becoming formidable foes.
